title: Great idea, nice design.
text: Well, I ordered this card specifically for how the box looked.  It was secured in a plastic bag....and whoever packaged it just shoved it in, and the bow was messed up.  I had to get my curling iron and fix it.  Frankly, that is ridiculous.  Fixable...but come on.  How hard is this for $100?!?  The idea and the design, great.  Very nice.  Execution, less so.

title: Watch what you are buying
text: Product was not what I expected. I wanted to get Ebay cards and not visa debit cards. Lesson learned.
